SHARED_BY_BOTH_ARMS.why: CCP_S2_SPEC.json#WARM_START_PROTOCOL.matched_exactly lists 'training seed' among the quantities that must be identical across arms. A differing seed would confound the CONTROL/TREATMENT contrast with initialisation and environment-assignment noise, which is precisely what the ATTRIBUTION_REFINEMENT Gamma statistic is meant to isolate.

DERIVED_ENVIRONMENT_RANGE.source: run_ccp_s2_production.py passes training_seed_range=(seed, seed+320) to configure_exp2b_live_environment, mirroring the predecessor's convention
DERIVED_ENVIRONMENT_RANGE.why_recorded: the assigned seed is not the only namespace this run consumes. Recording the derived range explicitly makes an accidental overlap with a reserved block checkable rather than merely unlikely -- the seed itself being disjoint is NOT sufficient evidence that the run is disjoint.
